ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55 percent high-intensity (yellowish-white) pixels to 45 percent low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large yellowish-white contiguous regions occupy the lateral lobes, bordered by a central dark vertical wedge that tapers into the notch and extends along the medial trailing edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 15 percent of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; significant macro-scale irregularity and pixel-amplitude spikes occur at the distal tips due to localized barnacle colonies.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory; trailing edge exhibits a primarily horizontal sweep with localized concavity near the central notch area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, dark-rimmed rosette clusters (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated in the mid-section of both the left and right light-colored lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent horizontal dark linear disruption on the lower left lobe and multiple diagonal intersecting dark lines on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Clusters of live barnacles (visible as protruding, textured geometric clusters) are present on the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive yellow-ochre pigmentation dominates the high-intensity regions of the ventral surface.
